# Workspace Instructions

- Build an AI-assisted appointment booking SaaS for home-service professionals.
- Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Keep the booking flow accessible, responsive, and clear for customers and providers.
- Treat AI output as suggestions: validate customer details, service category, availability, and booking confirmation before persisting appointments.
- Keep integrations replaceable; never commit secrets or make real calls/messages without explicit configuration.
- Document local setup and development commands in README.md.
